definitions.explanation: The direction or route that something is traveling, such as a typhoon, ship, or vehicle.
The direction of one's future education or career. Commonly used in school settings when students choose their next step.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the course of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進路|しんろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ずれた→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さかった→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧。
examples.english: Because the typhoon's course shifted east of the forecast, the damage was minor.

examples.japanese: {進路|しんろ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm struggling with what career path to take.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{進路|しんろ}⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a career counseling session with my teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、{進路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}め→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: In the third year of high school, you have to decide your future path — whether to go to university or get a job.

notes:
Sense 1 is common in weather reports and navigation. Sense 2 is a key word in Japanese school life, where {進路|しんろ}⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧ (career guidance) is a formal part of the curriculum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (decide one's path)
- {進路|しんろ}⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (career counseling)
- {進路|しんろ}⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧ (career guidance)
- {進路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ (change course)
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進路|しんろ} (typhoon's course)

Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{針路|しんろ}→針路：04034_shinro⟧, which specifically means a ship's or aircraft's navigational course.
